summary: Two-hand axe Enhancement built on Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon. It drops Windfury Totem for its group, plus Magma Totem. Another shaman's Flametongue Totem works on top of its Windfury Weapon.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -6s, Windfury Totem at -5s, Mana Spring at -4s, Lightning Shield at -3s, Magma Totem at -1.5s. The totems last the fight, except the last few seconds of a 300s one.
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Magma Totem when it is down, with at least 2s left
Rage of the Farseer with the on-use trinket, and Blood Fury with them
Other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion)
Fire Nova while Clearcasting is up
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova while mana is above 12 per second of fight left
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs 4 times a minute per point. The November 2 notes doubled its chance, over the old guess of 2. The rate is server side.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Strength of Earth stops at rank IV and Battle Shout at VI. The books would add about 7.7 DPS.
Only one 2% crit elixir. Stacking Mongoose, Grizzly and Owl would add about 36 DPS.
Stormstrike (150%, 6s), Maelstrom Weapon, Mental Dexterity, Flurry and the shocks take the November 2 notes' values. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry them yet.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.
Fire Nova uses client build 70425's values: 0.143 coefficient, rank 5 base damage 232 to 259.
Assumed: another shaman's Flametongue Totem stacks with this shaman's Windfury Weapon. It adds 18 to 19 DPS at 180s and isn't tested in game yet.
Convection 3 and Tidal Focus 2 in place of Reverberation 5 since the November 2 notes, +11 at 180s. Convection 4, Improved Stormstrike 1 and Tidal Focus 3 ties it (+2.5 at 120s, -2 to -3 at 300s).
The relic is Totem of the Storm, 0.9 to 2.1 DPS ahead of Burning Totem at every fight length. It lets Lightning Bolt trigger Maelstrom Weapon at half the chance.
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl optimized (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totem is a second shaman's Grace of Air, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself). Windshaper Skyborne since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Orc. Orc since the second 2026-10-27 race re-pick (after dev notes post 8: Orc Blood Fury 2 min, Troll Berserking 15 s, Undead Touch of the Grave 15 s; the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Windshaper Skyborne. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
